Dan Madsen, president of the Official Star Wars Fan Club and founder of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''. The promotional image also shows him as the kaadu handler in ''The Phantom Menace'' (top left), the scene on [[Dams Denna]], and Kenny Baker with R2-D2 (top right).

Source: [https://prcelebrity.com/dan-madsen Dan Madsen], PR Celebrity. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200212072501/http://prcelebrity.com:80/dan-madsen/ Internet Archive], 12 February 2020. Image file copied from [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:Dan_Madsen.jpg File:Dan Madsen.jpg] on Wookieepedia (1343 by 1550 pixels; uploaded 30 July 2020, which cites the same PR Celebrity page). Reduced to 600 by 692 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: cd9e817e8bad9872bb957bd2098a4b891bf2116afb1522f95230cfe8b23cc6e0.

Photographer: unknown. The source page does not name one.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single reduced-size promotional photo of Dan Madsen, used only to identify him on [[Dan Madsen]] and on [[Anagrams]] beside the card whose title is an anagram of his name, on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot harm any market for the original, and no free photo of him is known.
